acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Baseline Strategy projects paying only minimum payments on all accounts with no extra payments applied
Snowball Strategy applies surplus to smallest balance first, rolls payment to next smallest on payoff
Avalanche Strategy applies surplus to highest interest rate first, rolls payment to next highest on payoff

Each strategy returns StrategyProjection with all required fields: strategyId, strategyName, effortLevel, debtFreeMonth, debtFreeDate, totalInterestPaid, totalPrincipalPaid, monthsSaved, interestSaved, monthlyProjections[]
Effort levels assigned: Baseline = 'low', Snowball = 'low', Avalanche = 'low'
All strategies implement DebtStrategy interface with calculate() and allocatePayment() methods
Unit tests verify Avalanche saves more interest than Snowball, and Snowball has faster early wins
All calculations use big.js for precision with cent-level accuracy (2 decimal places in ZAR)

constraints.constraint: All monetary calculations must use big.js (ADR-003)
Round to 2 decimal places (cent-level accuracy in ZAR)
Strategies implement common DebtStrategy interface (Strategy Pattern - ADR-004)
Use generateProjection() with custom allocators, not duplicate projection logic
Snowball: sort by balance ascending, allocate all surplus to smallest non-zero
Avalanche: sort by rate descending, allocate all surplus to highest rate non-zero
Rolling: when target paid off, surplus goes to next in order

tests.standards: Vitest testing framework. Tests organized in tests/lib/calculations/ directory. Use describe blocks referencing ACs (e.g., "AC-4.3.1"). Big number assertions use .toFixed(2) for comparison. Spreadsheet-verified calculations for validation.
